HOSTING_COST_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the cost dimension: hosting.cost.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

text.en: The plugin’s measured CPU cost is above the ceiling for this rate and quantum. Raise the ceiling, or use a plugin that costs less.
text.ca: El cost de CPU mesurat del connector supera el límit per a aquesta freqüència i quàntum. Pugeu el límit, o useu un connector que costi menys.

text.en: The cost measurement is missing fields it needs. Measure the plugin’s cost again, completely.
text.ca: A la mesura de cost li falten camps que calen. Torneu a mesurar el cost del connector, de manera completa.

text.en: The plugin’s CPU cost has a spiky tail: occasional blocks cost much more than the rest. Treat it as unreliable at this rate and quantum.
text.ca: El cost de CPU del connector té una cua amb pics: alguns blocs costen molt més que la resta. Tracteu-lo com a poc fiable a aquesta freqüència i quàntum.

text.en: The plugin’s CPU cost has not been measured at this rate and quantum. Measure it before relying on a ceiling.
text.ca: El cost de CPU del connector no s’ha mesurat a aquesta freqüència i quàntum. Mesureu-lo abans de confiar en cap límit.

text.en: The plugin’s measured CPU cost is within the ceiling for this rate and quantum.
text.ca: El cost de CPU mesurat del connector és dins el límit per a aquesta freqüència i quàntum.
